params.sql:
WITH s AS (SELECT month, total_sm_spend FROM mart.sm_monthly),
n AS (SELECT month, new_customers FROM mart.monthly_metrics),
j AS (SELECT s.month AS mes, s.total_sm_spend AS sm_total_u,
             LEAD(n.new_customers) OVER (ORDER BY s.month) AS altas_mes_siguiente
      FROM s LEFT JOIN n ON n.month = s.month)
SELECT mes, ROUND(sm_total_u,3) AS sm_total_u, altas_mes_siguiente
FROM j WHERE altas_mes_siguiente IS NOT NULL AND mes >= '2022-02' ORDER BY mes
